onebotCindy.settings.wechatBot.title: Personal WeChat
onebotCindy.settings.wechatBot.authoriza: Tencent's webpage will open for authorization. After scanning, you can talk to your teammate from WeChat.
This WeChat account already has a connection. Continuing may replace its existing connection, such as OpenClaw.
onebotCindy.settings.wechatBot.workingDi: The selected directory is unavailable. New conversations temporarily use a WinOne-managed directory.
onebotCindy.settings.wechatBot.unbind.de: Unbinding stops messaging, removes local WeChat credentials, and clears unfinished tasks. Existing sessions, history, and saved attachments remain.
onebotCindy.settings.wechatBot.companion: Chat with {{name}} on WeChat, sharing memory and the main task. This computer’s WeChat connection can belong to one teammate at a time.
WeChat is linked to another teammate. Remove that link in their connection settings or Personal WeChat settings first.
onebotCindy.bots.autonomy.title: Follow Up on My Sessions
onebotCindy.bots.autonomy.routineScopeHi: Include sessions you create yourself. The built-in follow-up below responds to changes in assigned sessions.
onebotCindy.bots.autonomy.allowScheduler: Let {{name}} follow up on sessions it starts
By default, {{scheduler}} only watches. When this is on and a session {{name}} started isn't finished, {{scheduler}} follows up on it too.
onebotCindy.bots.autonomy.consent: Once enabled, I’ll read summaries of sessions you create on this computer, assess progress, and let you know about important changes. This uses your model allowance. You can disable it anytime.
onebotCindy.bots.autonomy.invitation.tit: Would you like me to follow up on your sessions?

onebotCindy.bots.capabilities.title: Capabilities
onebotCindy.bots.capabilities.inputHando: When this teammate reaches a sign-in, password or code it can't type itself, it may ask you to type it on any of your devices. Your values are never shared with it.
onebotCindy.bots.capabilities.intro: Choose which skills, tools and MCP servers this teammate can use. Changes apply from the next message.
onebotCindy.bots.capabilities.core.name: Teammate core
onebotCindy.bots.capabilities.core.note: The orchestration every teammate has. It can’t be turned off or edited. To change how this teammate works, tell it in chat and it will keep that as its own skill.
onebotCindy.bots.capabilities.core.items: Knows which tasks it can control and which computers are available. Arranges and follows up on tasks as you request, brings results back, and checks supported operations before working across computers.
Messages other teammates or creates a new one for you.
Switches models when you ask; finds and uses tools and plugins as needed.
Remembers your preferences and background, checking before use and updating when things change.
Understands WinOne’s features and usage, and checks or changes settings as you request. Asks you in the task when your input or confirmation is needed.
onebotCindy.bots.capabilities.system.ite: Keeps what you ask for and what it notices, and reminds you when due.
It stops recording, tidying and reminding you of todos. Existing todos are kept and resume when you switch this back on.
Sets up and maintains routines that run on a schedule.
It stops creating or changing routines. Existing routines keep running and stay manageable on the Routines page.
Watches how all your tasks are going and follows up on the ones you hand to it.
It stops checking and following up on your tasks on its own. You can still ask it in chat.
onebotCindy.bots.capabilities.learned.us: Turned off, the skill is kept but not used.
onebotCindy.bots.capabilities.learned.de: The teammate will stop using this skill and its content can’t be restored. If you need it later, ask it to remember the method again.
onebotCindy.bots.channels.title: Messaging platforms
onebotCindy.bots.channels.status.conflic: Another device is using this bot
onebotCindy.bots.channels.empty: Add a bot you already have, or connect personal WeChat below, and {{name}} will reply there.
This bot stops replying, its credentials are deleted from this computer, and its hidden tasks are archived. {{name}}’s memory and personality stay the same.
